commits.message:
docs(readme): drop the bug log and shrink demo coverage to a pointer (rich-subtraction-8wh.1) (#134)

The README's demo-coverage section had drifted from the check it
described: it said every public export must be referenced under
examples/, which stopped being true when types moved to reachability
from a demonstrated value. Beneath it sat a table of bugs the demos once
caught, a changelog entry on the npm landing page.

Both go. What remains is three sentences naming
test/coverage/coverage.test.ts and its allowlist as the answer to what
the demos cover. The "Coverage summary" and "Not yet exercised" sections
the ticket also names were already removed before this change.
